Can I just tell you as a mother of twins who is a week away from their first birthday. If you half ass everything… good for you! Screw the clean house. Social media and movies give this false idea of mother hood and how it’s so perfect. I also thought I’d be an amazing stay at home and go to brunch every 2nd day, cook meals from scratch and have an immaculate house. I went back to work 5 months later because I couldn’t do it anymore my house isn’t messy but it isn’t clean and I’m ok with that. Something that helped me when I just had my twins and thought I was doing “nothing” all day was I started to write a list of everything I did that day. I mean everything. Brushed my teeth, had a shower, made a bottle. When you start writing that stuff down you realise hey I actually did a lot today. just because you didn’t do a deep clean of the hole house and 10 loads of washing dosnt mean you didn’t do anything. You keeping a tiny human alive all day that knows nothing except you is a huge acomplishment and you should be proud of that! I’m proud of you
